cohort: Pregnant women participating in the Japan Environment and Children's Study.
finding: Early and late PPROM were associated with a higher incidence of several pregnancy complications, including oligohydramnios, intrauterine infection, cesarean delivery, placental abruption, and low 5-minute Apgar scores.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was more common in both early (OR 3.31, 95% CI 2.32, 4.71) and late PPROM (OR 1.34, 95% CI 0.97, 1.85) compared to no PPROM.
